_meta.description: Maps each Market Assessment domain cluster to the specific framework domain IDs from NIST CSF 2.0, CIS Controls v8.1.2, and ISO/IEC 27001:2022. When a cluster is selected on the frontend, these domain_keys are passed directly to build_questionnaire_from_selection().
_meta.notes: NIST domain IDs: GV=Govern, ID=Identify, PR=Protect, DE=Detect, RS=Respond, RC=Recover. CIS domain IDs are numeric (1-18). ISO domain IDs are numeric chapter numbers (5=Organizational, 6=People, 7=Physical, 8=Technological).

clusters.description: Covers identity lifecycle, authentication, access control, privileged access, and identity monitoring.

framework_domain_rationale.nist-csf-2-0:PR: PR.AA (Access Control) covers identity management, authentication, MFA, SSO, least privilege, PAM
framework_domain_rationale.nist-csf-2-0:DE: DE.CM (Continuous Monitoring) covers identity and access log monitoring, UEBA, anomalous access alerts
framework_domain_rationale.cis-controls-v8-1-2:5: CIS Control 5 — Account Management: Establish and maintain an inventory of all accounts, enforce MFA, remove dormant accounts
framework_domain_rationale.cis-controls-v8-1-2:6: CIS Control 6 — Access Control Management: RBAC, least privilege, access reviews, privileged access
framework_domain_rationale.iso-27001-2022:5: ISO 27001 Clause 5 Organizational Controls: Access control policy, identity management governance, privileged access policy
framework_domain_rationale.iso-27001-2022:8: ISO 27001 Clause 8 Technological Controls: 8.2 Privileged access rights, 8.5 Secure authentication, 8.18 PAM

clusters.description: Covers network architecture, perimeter controls, segmentation, remote access, traffic monitoring, and wireless security.

framework_domain_rationale.nist-csf-2-0:PR: PR.PS (Platform Security) and PR.IR (Infrastructure Resilience) cover network architecture, segmentation, and access
framework_domain_rationale.nist-csf-2-0:DE: DE.CM covers network traffic monitoring, IDS/IPS, anomaly detection
framework_domain_rationale.cis-controls-v8-1-2:12: CIS Control 12 — Network Infrastructure Management: Secure network architecture, firewall management, segmentation
framework_domain_rationale.cis-controls-v8-1-2:13: CIS Control 13 — Network Monitoring and Defense: IDS/IPS, DNS filtering, traffic analysis, threat detection
framework_domain_rationale.iso-27001-2022:7: ISO 27001 Clause 7 Physical Controls: Physical network security, cabling security, equipment placement
framework_domain_rationale.iso-27001-2022:8: ISO 27001 Clause 8 Technological Controls: 8.20 Networks security, 8.21 Security of network services, 8.22 Segregation of networks

clusters.description: Covers cloud adoption governance, cloud security posture management, cloud workload security, and cloud logging.

framework_domain_rationale.nist-csf-2-0:ID: ID.AM (Asset Management) covers cloud account/subscription inventory and workload discovery

framework_domain_rationale.iso-27001-2022:8: ISO 27001 Clause 8: 8.23 Web filtering, 8.25 Secure development, cloud workload security controls

framework_domain_rationale.nist-csf-2-0:DE: DE.CM covers M365 audit log ingestion and alert configuration

clusters.description: Covers AI tool governance, data exposure risks from generative AI, shadow AI detection, and AI output review.
